comments_clusters.representative_excerpt: Section II.A lists CAA section 193 — the bar on relaxing nonattainment-area control requirements without equivalent-or-greater emissions reductions — as an evaluation criterion for this action, alongside sections 110(a)(2) and 110(l). Section I.A states that the Riverside County portion of the District is designated unclassifiable/attainment for all NAAQS....
